question: Which of the following is an open source operating system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Android**__.

__
 
• An Open-source Operating System is the Operating System in which source code is visible publically and editable.
 
• The operating system is a collection of programs that controls the overall operations of the computer.
 
• **Android is an open-source operating system.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Other Examples of operating systems are:
 
 
• Linux.
 
• Unix.
 
• DOS.
 
• Windows.
 
• Ubuntu.
 
• Embedded operating system.
 
• OpenBSD.
 
• Mac OS.
